description: Turn photo(s) into a short video. With `effect` (from list_effects) the effect decides the motion; without it the photo is animated following `prompt`. Costs credits. Returns a task_id; poll get_video for the result (usually 1–5 minutes).

description.name: create_video
description.description: Generate a short video (5 seconds, 720p, with sound) from a text description only, no photo needed. Costs credits. Returns a task_id; poll get_video.

description.name: edit_video
description.description: Edit an existing video clip (MP4, up to 15 seconds, 50 MB) following instructions: put the person from a photo into the clip, change outfit, style, background or scene, while keeping the motion and timing. Costs credits (based on clip length). Returns a task_id; poll get_video.

description.name: create_image
description.description: Generate a new image from text, or edit photo(s) following instructions (change background, outfit, style, lighting, combine several photos). Uses Nano Banana 2 at 1K. Costs credits. Usually returns the image directly; if status is pending, call get_image later.

description.name: restore_photo
description.description: Repair an old or damaged photo: remove scratches, dust, creases and fading, recover sharp faces, keep everyone exactly as they are. Optionally colorize a black-and-white photo. Costs credits. Returns the restored image (or pending → get_image). Tip: animate the result with animate_photo afterwards.

description.name: get_image
description.description: Check an image task from create_image or restore_photo. status is pending, success (image_url ready) or failed (credits refunded).

description.name: get_video
description.description: Check a generation task. status is pending, success (video_url ready) or failed (credits refunded).

description.name: list_my_videos
description.description: The user's most recent video generations, newest first.

description.name: get_credits
description.description: Remaining credits and plan of the connected account.
